item.title: Invited speaker at "AI Meets Food Science"
item.description: I was invited by Professor of the to give a talk at the workshop. It was extremely interesting to hear recurring themes across all presentations, such as dealing with limited amount of training data and introducing codified expert knowledge in machine learning models. I particulary enjoyed the talk by Professor from Wageningen University, The Netherlands, as we shared several research topics related to food processing.
